name: pig iron
lore_descriptor: rough cast, still pitted from the bloomery
first_pickup_chronicle: Pig iron — straight from the bloomery, full of slag the smith never burned out. Brutal. Heavy. Won't take an enchantment, won't keep an edge — but it'll cave a helmet.
design_notes: Band A heavy metal. High mult (1.20), heavy (1.5 weight), enchant cap 1. Sister-archetype to tungsten — early-game brute material. Fills the F1-15 heavy gap.
